verdict.rationale: Universal search is a fair axis for a spend-management platform like Brex, but the pack never mentions a universal search bar spanning transactions, vendors, and cards, or a jump from search into starting a payment. The separate Transactions, Payments and Team APIs and the MCP server are developer building blocks and adjacent features, not the in-product search capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can search across all transactions, vendors, and cards from one universal search bar and jump straight into initiating a payment
